main_text.p: Sed tamen venustula, Hinc velut mapalibus Quæ tetendit Æthiops Educata fordidis: Inde talis qualia Sollomonis fulgida Cernimus tentoria.

6. Ergo ne me, virgines, Ceu nigellam, spernite, Decolorem torridi Solis æstu reddidam: Dum misella, fratribus, Vna communis quibus Contigit parens mihi, Me foras pellentibus, Exteras ad vineas, Exulo procul meam Tristis extra vincam.

7. At meum corculum, Expetenti te mihi, Quæso te, renuntia, Gregem vbi pascas tuum. Grata vbi tuo gregi. Solis æstu feruidi Præbeas vmbracula. Næque ad istorum greges, Qui sodales se tuos Impudenter iactitant, Ceu latebras quæritans, Cur ego confedero?
main_text.head: SPONSVS.
main_text.p: 8. Tène vero nesciam Hoc rogare dixerim, Virginum pulcherrima? Qua meus gregex, defpice. Prata tundens florea.
10. O genarum fulgidis Hinc & hinc inauribus Temperatam purpuram! O nouum colli decus, Torque cincti gemmeo!
11. Istud & tamen decus Ecce me iuuat nouis Auditare honoribus: Sparsi mox argenteis Clauulis monilia Additurus aurea,
main_text.head: SPONSA.
main_text.p: 12. Euge, Rex gregalibus Cinctus accubat suis, Sponsa cuius ad latus Ter beata confidens, Tota nardi diffluo Suaue olentis vnguin^a.
13. Ille verò molliter Se sinu condens meo, Charus vnicè mihi, Affidentem recreat, Fascis instar myrrheis:

page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so lines end abruptly; the running head is cut at its right end. The line "Prata tundens florea." carries a marginal mark at the left edge. Doubtful readings: "gregex" may be "grex"; "Qua meus gregex" is as printed. Lower part of the page; the upper part is cut off. Some letters in the verse are doubtful (e.g. "vnguin^a" at line end, possibly "vnguina"), and the ligature-like mark after "vnguin" is uncertain.
